theorems.name: Submission.dimred_blowup_limit_moving_centres
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ (x : Euclid (n + k)) (xs : ℕ → Euclid (n + k)) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + k))) n), StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp T (xs (φ j)) (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T (xs (φ j)) (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C ∧ IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C
